written.headline: DeepSeek releases open‑source Super‑Agent, a proactive coding assistant prototype
written.summary: DeepSeek announced Super‑Agent, an open‑source research prototype that monitors a GitHub repo and developer chats, then suggests fixes or opens pull requests without being prompted. The code is under an MIT license and not production‑ready.

written.headline: Guidewire to acquire Hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash
written.summary: Insurance software maker Guidewire announced it will buy AI underwriting firm Hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash, with an additional earn‑out of up to $400 million. The deal adds AI‑powered pricing tools to Guidewire’s portfolio.

written.headline: Deepgram acquires Daily, keeping open‑source Pipecat framework intact
written.summary: Deepgram bought Daily, the maker of the open‑source voice AI framework Pipecat, for an undisclosed sum. Pipecat will remain open source under its BSD V2 licence and Daily’s team joins Deepgram.
